verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own marketing directly claims that agents get past all three wall types without user intervention: forms, CAPTCHAs, and login prompts are 'handled', and agents log in 'login walls included'. The evidence is only short homepage marketing lines, though, with no technical documentation of how CAPTCHA solving or credential handling works and no independent confirmation. missing for 10: technical docs on CAPTCHA-solving and authentication mechanisms, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically get past a CAPTCHA, login, or form wall without my manual intervention

citations.quote: When your workflow requires a form, a CAPTCHA, or a login prompt, it's handled.
Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included.
